meta_description: SNS Plastering Sheffield provides expert plastering for homes and businesses. Damp repairs, skimming, rendering. Free quotes. Call 07870 208179.
hero_eyebrow: Experienced Plasterer — Quality Finishes Every Time
hero_subhead: From damp repairs to interior skimming, SNS Plastering delivers flawless finishes on time and on budget.
services_subhead: Whether you need internal skimming, external rendering, or damp repairs, we handle it all with precision and care.

services.title: Internal Skimming & Finishing
services.desc: Smooth, professional skimming on plasterboard and existing walls. Creates a perfect base for decoration and transforms dated rooms in days.

services.title: External Rendering
services.desc: Weather-resistant external renders protect your property and boost kerb appeal. We use proven techniques and quality materials for long-lasting results.

services.title: Damp Repair & Tanking
services.desc: Identify and repair the root cause of damp. We apply tanking solutions and renders to keep moisture out and protect your walls for years.

services.title: Coving & Cornice Installation
services.desc: Add period detail or modern clean lines with professional coving and cornice fitting. Expertly installed and finished to a polished standard.

services.title: Ceiling Repairs & Artexing
services.desc: Fix damaged ceilings, remove old artex safely, or apply new textured finishes. Leave your ceilings looking smart and professional.

services.title: New Build & Renovation Plastering
services.desc: Full plastering packages for new builds and refurbishments. We work closely with contractors to meet schedules and maintain site standards.

about_pullquote: I treat every job as if it's my own home — that's how you get trust.
about_para_1: SNS Plastering was established over a decade ago by a team passionate about delivering high-quality finishes to homes and businesses across Sheffield. From small domestic repairs to large commercial projects, we've built our reputation on reliability, attention to detail, and fair pricing. Every member of our team is fully trained and insured.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we listen, arrive on time, and leave sites clean and tidy. We specialise in damp repairs and rendering — areas where experience really counts — and we're never afraid to explain the job properly so you understand exactly what's needed and why.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a nasty damp patch in the living room corner. SNS came round, explained what was causing it, and fixed it properly rather than just plastering over the problem. Three months on, still bone dry. Brilliant work and very fair price.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Skimmed three rooms for us before redecorating. Finish was immaculate. The lads were tidy, professional, and finished exactly when they said they would. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Claire P.

reviews.text: Called for an emergency repair after a ceiling started cracking. Got an appointment same week, and the job was done properly. They didn't try to sell me anything I didn't need. Will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: David K.

address_sub: Serving Sheffield and surrounding areas within 10 miles
emergency_banner_text: Urgent repair needed? We handle emergency call-outs same day. Ring us now —
footer_description: SNS Plastering is a Sheffield-based plastering specialist with 12 years' experience. We deliver expert internal skimming, rendering, damp repairs, and finishing work.
